text: [grateful] If not for you, Commander, I'd have ended up in their cargo hold. I won't forget this kindness.
[relieved] I'm alive... I'm really alive! Next time good goods come in, you'll be the first I call.
[warm] To think someone like you is still out here. I'll spread the word in the Merchants' Guild.
[moved] I knew you'd come... I protected the data. I'll go with you.
[earnest] So my research wasn't in vain. This mind — I'll lend it to your fleet.
[excited] While I was locked up, I completed an equation — I'd love to show you.
